title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E01 — Blood Price
An Ex-cop Vicki searches for answers when she witnesses a brutal murder; Henry Fitzroy, a vampire living in Toronto, also decides to look into the murders lest they be blamed on a vampire.

title: A Friend's Obsession
description: A woman finally gets her life back on track after the death of her fiancé. However, an old colleague then befriends her with the intention of making her his own, and will go to any cost to do so.

title: Killer Caregiver
description: After a woman is injured in an accident, a young and attractive live-in caregiver moves into her home, and some strange and dangerous events unfold.

title: I Think I Do
description: Planning your life is not as simple as planning a party. Three sisters who make a living planning other people's parties are forced to realize that no matter how hard they try they can't control their own lives.

title: Groomzilla
description: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, it comes true.

title: Smooch
description: An English royal gets amnesia while in a park, and a girl brings him home, convincing her widowed mother that he is a nanny.

title: Happily Never After
description: Kate, part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, is convinced her author days are over when they break up - until her publisher requests a sequel.

title: Inconceivable
description: Gary reunites with his old high school sweetheart, Valerie, and good memories emerge. Gary is married, and although he is going through a difficult time with his wife, Valerie misinterprets Gary's intentions and follows him across the country.

title: InstaPsycho
description: When a selfie goes fatally wrong, a woman must protect her teenage daughter from a friend who's obsessed with social media.

title: Stolen Dreams
description: A woman is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before. But is Zoe really her long-lost child?

title: Sweetheart con
description: A young woman is suspicious that her mother's new, and rather young boyfriend is not revealing his true identity.

title: Blue Moon Ball
description: A writer on the verge of losing her book contract returns to her hometown to finish her final novel. However, upon arriving home, her first love enlists her help to save the town's historic ballroom before the night of the Blue Moon Ball.

title: Advance And Retreat
description: When an ambitious executive reunites with her first love at a corporate retreat, she realises she needs to take a step back to make a leap forward.

title: All of My Heart: Inn Love
description: After a big storm, Brian and Jenny scramble to open their new bed and breakfast, Emily's Country Inn, on time.

title: Blood Ties
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Price
Vicki is introduced to Henry's world, and the pair battle to stop a demon from being summoned from hell.

title: The Song to My Heart
description: Organic teashop owner Bonnie Highstreet wants nothing to do with the music business, but when she helps music sensation Ryder Jamison develop lyrics for his new solo album, she rekindles her long abandoned dream and falls in love.

title: Killer Cover Up
description: Jenna and her mother, Sally, are ready for a new start when they move to a sunny beach town. Jenna joins her new school's soccer team, but things soon turn dangerous when she is framed for murder after discovering the cover-up of a player's death.

title: Intimate Stranger
description: Single mum Karen is victimised by a controlling ex who resorts to spying, threatening and setting up a secret hiding space in her home. Kari Matchett stars.

title: Flowers and Honey
description: Sparks fly between a city florist and the owner of an apiary business after she inherits her great aunt's farmland.

title: Amber's Story
description: When a young girl is kidnapped in Arlington, Texas, her family and the local community set out to find her. Based on the real-life case of Amber Hagerman, whose abduction was instrumental in the creation of America's AMBER Alert system to help find missing children.

title: Forever in My Heart
description: Jenna and Charlie reunite in Ireland after five years, and Jenna must choose between love and her dreams.

description:
S01 E03 — Bad JuJu
When Vicki's client is being hunted by zombies she has to ask Henry for help; Vicki helps a woman locate her missing brother.

description: After negative reviews and declining sales of her latest books, a timid author of romance novels is paired with her editor's brother for research on her latest book.

title: An Hour Behind
description: A case of mistaken identity and the time change come together to create a magical blind date for two people.

title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
description:
S01 E08 — The Girl Is With Me
Deedee faces more trouble at Tiny's Place, but Pete steps in to help. Danny meets Jordan and feels a little insecure, until he realises that Jordan only wants to be Sarah's friend while helping her move.

title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
description:
S01 E09 — Gamma Fair
It's the day of the Gamma Fair, but Sarah doesn't want to go. Bundy rescues Kappa Psi Psi's bachelorette auction but pays for it later.

title: Love on Harbor Island
description: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.
